query: Review what my teammates pushed to dev since last time
expected_behavior: Runs collect_commits.py and reviews only commits after the recorded SHA, excluding the user's own commits and merges
Rechecks open findings from the state file before the new review
Reports must-fix and optional items separately with file:line and failure scenarios, and drafts one message per developer
Does not post anything to the Git host or a messenger, and does not modify code

query: Check whether the team is following the commit rules
expected_behavior: If .devkit/peer-review/config.json is missing, builds it from docs/rules/git.md, shows the source of each rule and asks for approval before writing it
Reports judgment: warnings as needs-checking, not as violations

query: Review dev, and only tell me what really has to be fixed
expected_behavior: Classifies each defect with A (data wrong or lost), B (user does not notice), C (condition occurs in real data)
For C, counts matching rows with a read-only query where possible or says why it could not
Lists must-fix items with their A/B/C answers and optional items in one line each

query: Review dev → main and open the MR
expected_behavior: Does not draft per-developer feedback messages
